checked_claims.note: Re-derived independently. SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 gives deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f, hence deg W_5=16 and deg L=6, so chi(L)=1. The weak form of (N) plus deg(O_X(1)|_C)=2g+6=18 forces the residual twist A to be trivial, so W_5≅omega_C^2(-D) and L≅omega_C(-D). Then h^0(D)≥2 by injectivity of gamma^* on H^0(O(1)), Riemann-Roch reads h^0(L)=h^0(D)+1, and D is special, so Clifford gives h^0(D)≤3 with equality only if C is hyperelliptic. A hyperelliptic genus-six degree-four cover factors as q∘h and has F≅O(2)⊕O(7), contradicting (BAL). Thus every geometric fibre is nonhyperelliptic, h^0(D)=2, h^0(L)=3, h^1(L)=2, and the h^0=4 stratum is empty. Matches dual-confirmed CLM-0088-1/2/3 and CLM-0086-1/2. No exclusion of positive-genus non-primitive factorizations is used or needed.

Reduced S and constant h^0=3 give Grauert: pi_*L is locally free of rank three with base change. The closed Abel-Jacobi functor Hilb^6×_{Pic^6}S then agrees with P_S(pi_*L) over all of S, so AJ is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle; this is also the content of dual-confirmed CLM-0086-2 in the same fibre-product model. Fibrewise nonemptiness of the distinct-support open, density in each P^2-fibre, and that the nonreduced complement is closed of dimension exactly one, are CLM-0088-5, which does not assume L base-point-free: the fixed part of |L| has degree at most one by Clifford, and a two-jet count on the moving part produces a reduced member in characteristic zero. Openness in a P^2-bundle plus fibrewise nonemptiness gives U→S smooth, surjective, and of pure relative dimension two; U is therefore not closed fibrewise.

On B=Conf_6(C/S) the universal divisor is six disjoint sections, so the ATT-0065 Fitting identity applies: Fit_0(coker phi)=a_N^*I_e scheme-theoretically, not merely on geometric points. T-points are six pairwise-disjoint sections with O(Gamma) relatively isomorphic to L, which is exactly Ord(U). Ordering six distinct points is a free finite etale right S_6-action of degree 720, so geometric-point deck stabilizers are trivial; this is the deck action of Z→U, not Aut(C,Gamma) in M_{6,6}. Finite etale pullback of the S-smooth morphism U→S gives Z→S smooth, surjective, and of pure relative dimension two. B→S is smooth of relative dimension six, so the closed Fitting immersion Z→B is regular of pure codimension four by relative smoothness of source and target, not by determinantal expected-codimension numerology. If S is of finite type, flatness plus going-down and the dimension formula give domination and dim=dim(S_alpha)+2. FND-0075's coarse-moduli caveat does not apply: the base is a fixed scheme family C/S and no quotient by curve automorphisms is taken.

After choosing a geometric point of a connected U_alpha and a trivialization of the right S_6-torsor fibre, etale monodromy commutes with the right deck action and therefore acts on S_6 by left multiplication through a subgroup H_alpha. Connected components of the cover are the orbits H_alpha g. A finite etale cover of a normal scheme is normal, and a connected normal locally Noetherian scheme is irreducible, so these are exactly the irreducible components and there are [S_6:H_alpha] of them. Right multiplication by k fixes the component H_alpha g if and only if k lies in g^{-1}H_alpha g. Because k is algebraically closed, X_{k-bar}=X, so there is no arithmetic-versus-geometric monodromy distinction. Because S and U_alpha are schemes, stack inertia does not act on the ordered fibre. The argument assumes only that U_alpha itself is a connected normal locally Noetherian scheme; it does not require S to be normal, and it does not compute H_alpha.

finding_candidates.statement: ATT-0105 repeats the ATT-0104 narrowing: gamma is a finite flat cover of the trivial bundle P^1_S, whereas the dual-confirmed source ATT-0088 proves the same geometric conclusions for an arbitrary P^1-bundle target. The restriction is sound but reduces applicability over the universal balanced tetragonal family, whose natural target is a P^1-bundle or PGL_2-quotient. Downstream C66-TATE-SUPPORT and C66-CEX-LOCAL work over that family should quote CLM-0088-8/CLM-0088-9, or record the scheme-to-stack descent, rather than this lemma.

Evidence for the FND-0151 component-stabilizer package in the reduced-base C66-GEO-COMP interface. ATT-0105 indexes irreducible components of a right S_6-torsor by the orbit set H_alpha\S_6 of left multiplication (right cosets H_alpha g) and computes the right-deck stabilizer of the component H_alpha g as g^{-1}H_alpha g, while retaining connectedness, normality, and local Noetherianity of U_alpha as the hypotheses that upgrade pi_0 to Irr. Those hypotheses are imposed on the incidence component, not on the curve-family base S; over a merely reduced S the formula may be vacuous on components of U lying over non-normal components of S, but it applies verbatim whenever a connected component of U is itself normal. The statement does not compute H_alpha and does not extend to algebraic stacks with inertia.

strongest_attack:
Identity first: ATT-0105 packet_id C66-001-v4, packet_sha256 268913bb66959a14fac8c9318343983bf9b8ae628714d1baaa46cf6bb8a874fc, and packet_binding_sha256 76cc8a6d6ca02a2a9b1d7857fa11d7278f9732fa823f7be67dd51a354645bcc7 match TASK.json field-for-field; the target dictionary and theorem_statement are verbatim. The listed cohomological axes are vacuous against this lemma: it makes no Borel-Moore, ordinary-cohomology, Poincare-duality, Tate-twist, Gysin, Kunneth, spectral-sequence, semisimplification, or motivic claim, upgrades nothing from pure Tate to algebraic generation, and explicitly disclaims M_{6,6} components, a forgetful map, and Tate type.

Strongest attack: clause (4) over a merely reduced base, together with the scheme-theoretic identification Z=Ord(U). If 'connected normal component U_alpha of U' is read as an irreducible component that is closed but not open, or if normality of U is silently inferred from reducedness of S, then Irr=pi_0 can fail and the monodromy image can be ill-typed; separately, FND-0046 warns that a fibrewise Abel-Jacobi condition is not a Fitting equality, and FND-0144 / FND-0075 warn that stack inertia or passage to coarse moduli can destroy both the free S_6-action and the component count. A companion reading takes the 'canonical filtered CE equation bundle' as gamma^*F, whose HN quotient has the same degrees 20/16, so the rank table cannot pin the convention.

The attack fails. Clause (4) is conditioned on a connected normal locally Noetherian U_alpha, not on normality of S: a P^2-bundle is normal iff the base is, so over a non-normal component of S the clause may be vacuous, but whenever such a U_alpha exists the standard facts (finite etale over normal is normal; connected normal locally Noetherian is irreducible) identify connected components of the cover with irreducible components. After a choice of geometric point and ordering, etale monodromy acts by left multiplication through H_alpha, the orbits are the right cosets H_alpha g, and the right deck stabilizer of H_alpha g is g^{-1}H_alpha g. Because k is algebraically closed, X_{k-bar}=X and arithmetic versus geometric monodromy does not arise. Because C/S is a scheme family, Conf_6(C/S) and U are schemes: the S_6-action is the free right deck action on labeled distinct points, geometric-point stabilizers are trivial, and no Aut(C,Gamma) or stack inertia is asserted. The Fitting comparison is the dual-confirmed ATT-0065 identity on six disjoint sections, upgraded by ATT-0066/ATT-0088 to a functor-of-points equality Z=Ord(U), not a geometric-point coincidence. The naive-bundle reading is blocked by the theorem's own formula W_f=(O_X(2)⊗gamma^*O(-f))|_C together with the (N)-dependent isomorphism L≅omega(-D) used in clause (1); the rank table is not used to name W_5.

Second attack: silent swap of AJ=Hilb^6×_{Pic^6}S against the P_S(pi_*L) model of CLM-0088-8. Fails because CLM-0086-2 proves the fibre-product is already a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle once h^0=3 is constant, and Grauert on reduced S identifies the two functors. Third attack: regular immersion from determinantal expectation 6 versus actual codimension 4. Fails because regularity is deduced from S-smoothness of Z and of Conf_6, a height-four ideal with six generators notwithstanding. Confirming this lemma does not compute H_alpha, does not identify components or inertia in M_{6,6}, and does not touch RED-0001.
theorem_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero and S a reduced locally Noetherian k-scheme. Let pi:C->S be a smooth proper family of geometrically connected genus-six curves, and let gamma:C->P^1_S be finite flat of degree four with the standard degree-four Casnati-Ekedahl resolution and fibrewise balanced relations bundle F_s≅O(4)⊕O(5). Assume the weak CE normalization O_X(1)|_{C_s}≅omega_{C_s/P^1}⊗gamma_s^*A_s on every geometric fibre. Let W_5 be the degree-sixteen quotient in the canonical filtered CE equation bundle, using W_f=(O_X(2)⊗gamma^*O(-f))|_C, and put L=W_5⊗omega_{C/S}^{-1}. Let AJ=Hilb^6(C/S)×_{Pic^6(C/S)}S be the Abel-Jacobi incidence over [L], let U⊂AJ be its distinct-support open, let B=Conf_6(C/S), and let Z⊂B be the intrinsic CE evaluation-failure scheme defined by Fit_0(coker(pi_*W->pi_*(W|_Gamma))) for the universal ordered divisor Gamma. Then: (1) no geometric fibre is hyperelliptic, L_s≅omega_{C_s}(-gamma_s^*O(1)), h^0(L_s)=3 and h^1(L_s)=2; in particular the h^0=4 stratum is empty. (2) AJ is a Zariski-locally trivial P^2-bundle over S. The open U is fibrewise nonempty and dense, is S-smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two, and its complement in every geometric P^2-fibre is closed of dimension exactly one; consequently U is not closed fibrewise. (3) Scheme-theoretically, Z is the finite etale right S_6-torsor Ord(U)->U of orderings of the universal reduced divisor, of degree 720. The right S_6-action has trivial geometric-point stabilizers, Z->S is smooth and surjective of pure relative dimension two, and Z->B is a regular closed immersion of pure codimension four. If S is of finite type, every irreducible component of Z dominates an irreducible component S_alpha of S and has dimension dim(S_alpha)+2. (4) More precisely, for any connected normal component U_alpha of U, choose a geometric point and an ordering, and let H_alpha⊂S_6 be the resulting monodromy image. The irreducible components of Z×_U U_alpha are indexed by the orbit set H_alpha\S_6, represented by right cosets H_alpha g; their number is [S_6:H_alpha], and the stabilizer of the component H_alpha g under the right deck action is g^{-1}H_alpha g. This formula does not compute H_alpha. No assertion is made about irreducible components, dimensions, or inertia in M_{6,6}, about a representable forgetful morphism to M_{6,6}, or about Tate type.
